# Solana NFT Creation Toolkit

> Create, mint, verify, update and inspect professional NFTs on Solana with
> Metaplex Token Metadata, Umi and Arweave (Irys). Mint one item or a whole
> collection from a manifest, with batches and built-in fee optimization.
> Includes a production CLI and an installable AI agent skill.

## Install

```bash
git clone --branch v2.4.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/devcodex2025/Creation-of-NFT-Solana
cd Creation-of-NFT-Solana
npm ci
cp .env.example .env
npm run keypair
```

## Commands

- `npx esrun src/commands/create-collection.ts` — create a Metaplex collection NFT.
- `npx esrun src/commands/create-nft.ts` — mint an NFT into the collection and verify it.
- `npx esrun src/commands/create-batch.ts` — mint a whole collection from one manifest, in batches, with resume.
- `npx esrun src/commands/verify-collection.ts` — verify an existing NFT's collection membership.
- `npx esrun src/commands/update-nft.ts` — update metadata, image, royalty, authority or immutability.
- `npx esrun src/commands/show-nft.ts` — print on-chain and off-chain NFT data.
- `npx esrun src/commands/balance.ts` — show the wallet balance.
- `npm run test:e2e` — full local-validator test.
- `npm run test:bridge` — security checks for the browser wallet bridge.

Prefer `npx esrun` over `npm run` on Windows PowerShell 7 with npm 11: npm drops
the first `--` and the flags never reach the script.

## Signing

- Default: keypair file from `--keypair`, `KEYPAIR_PATH`, `./keypair.json` or
  `~/.config/solana/id.json`. Explicit paths must exist.
- `--signer browser`: Phantom, Solflare or Backpack sign through a temporary
  page on `127.0.0.1`. The key never leaves the extension. A human must approve
  four requests per item mint (two uploads, mint, verification) and three for
  the collection, plus one storage payment when Irys needs funding. A batch
  needs three approvals for the whole collection, plus one per 20 items with
  `--verify-creators`.
- `--signer readonly`: no signer, for commands that only read.

Every fee is paid on chain to Solana and to storage; the toolkit takes no fee.

## Skill

`skills/solana-nft-creation/SKILL.md` — professional NFT creation workflow for AI
agents. Install with:

```bash
npx skills add https://github.com/devcodex2025/Creation-of-NFT-Solana/tree/v2.4.0/skills/solana-nft-creation
```

The skill works from plain language: describe the result, approve the signatures
in your wallet, and it creates the collection, uploads to Arweave, mints,
verifies and reports the addresses. It mints one item or a whole collection from
a manifest, runs on devnet or mainnet (devnet first is recommended), and signs
through Phantom, Solflare or Backpack.

Verify discovery without installing:

```bash
npx skills add https://github.com/devcodex2025/Creation-of-NFT-Solana -l
```

The skill drives the CLI above; clone the pinned toolkit first. Example prompt:

> Create a collection called "Lil Turtles" with symbol LIL and a 5% royalty on
> devnet, then mint one item and confirm it is verified on chain.

Or for a folder of art:

> Mint the whole collection in `abstract-lil-turtles/collection.json` on devnet.
> Show me the addresses, then tell me what a mainnet run would cost.

See "Install the skill" at the top of the README.

## Notes for AI agents

- Token Metadata limits: name ≤ 32 bytes, symbol ≤ 10, URI ≤ 200.
- Always verify collection membership and re-fetch the asset after a mint.
- For a whole collection, use `create:batch` and run it on devnet first; it
  refuses mainnet without `--mainnet`.
- Batch verification uses `delegateCollectionV1` and `revokeCollectionV1` with
  `MetadataDelegateRole.Collection`, not the legacy `approveCollectionAuthority`.
- Upload the image before the metadata JSON.
- Never set `isMutable: false` before metadata is final.
- Never handle seed phrases. Use a keypair file, `--signer browser`, or a wallet
  adapter.
- Never choose `--signer browser` for an unattended run; it needs a human.
